full_prompt_en:
A solitary figure stands on a dark rocky ledge overlooking a vast valley filled with low white mist. The viewer sees the figure from behind, small in the frame and facing a distant mesa beneath a muted dawn sky. Jagged stones and sparse grasses form the near foreground, while darker islands of rock emerge from the fog at irregular intervals. Low ridges roll back toward the horizon. The sky changes from cool slate blue above to lavender and amber near a pale hidden sun, and the mist catches that warmth in thin horizontal bands. The scene turns a simple pause into an expansive encounter with distance.

The painting is careful and atmospheric rather than sharply descriptive. Rocky foreground edges are dark, crisp, and granular, while the valley dissolves through soft layers of blue-grey, lilac, and cream. Small controlled strokes describe broken stone and cloud texture, but the far land becomes smoothly veiled. Backlighting gives the figure a clear dark outline without revealing details. The composition places the ledge near the lower third; most of the space belongs to the rolling fog and wide sky. Warm light along the horizon gently counters the cold shadow below. The mood is solemn, hushed, and reflective, with a tactile oil-painted surface and no legible text in the selected image.
full_prompt_zh:
一道孤独身影站在深色岩架上，俯望铺满低矮白雾的辽阔山谷。观看者从背后看到他：人物在画幅中很小，面向柔和黎明天空下远处的平顶山。锯齿状石块与稀疏草丛形成近景，较暗的岩石岛影不规则地从雾中冒出。低缓山脊向地平线一层层退去。天空由上方的冷石板蓝，变化到近处隐约太阳旁的淡紫和琥珀色；薄雾以细长水平带捕捉这份暖意。场景把简单驻足化成与巨大距离的相遇。

绘画细致而重气氛，并非处处锐利描述。岩石前景边缘深、清晰且有颗粒感，山谷则经由蓝灰、淡紫和乳白的柔和层次渐渐消散。受控的小笔触描写断石与云雾纹理，远方土地则被平滑的轻纱遮住。逆光给予人物清楚的深色轮廓，却不展示细部。构图让岩架接近下三分之一，滚动的雾与宽阔天空占去多数空间。地平线处的暖光温柔地对照下方冷影。情绪庄严、寂静而沉思，表面具有可触的油画质感，所选图像没有可辨认文字。
style_prompt_en: A dark granular foreground edge opens into a vast sequence of soft mist layers and low blue-grey ridges. Small controlled strokes give nearby rough surfaces a tactile edge, while distant forms dissolve into lilac, cream, and muted amber haze. A broad slate-blue sky grades gently toward a warm horizon. A tiny crisp silhouette provides scale without disturbing the quiet field of open space. Backlight clarifies the nearest edges and turns the mist into thin horizontal bands of pale glow. The lower portion is weighty and sharply textured; the upper distance becomes increasingly smooth and diffuse. The oil-painted finish is solemn and atmospheric, with restrained color and a slow rhythm of receding planes.
style_prompt_zh: 深色而有颗粒感的前层边缘，打开层层柔软薄雾与低矮蓝灰山脊的辽阔序列。受控的小笔触给近处粗糙表面可触的边，远处形状则融入淡紫、乳白和暗琥珀色霭气。大片石板蓝天空温柔过渡到暖色地平线。一道微小清晰的剪影提供尺度，不打破开放空间的安静。逆光澄清近处边缘，并让薄雾化成细长水平的淡亮带。下方有分量且纹理锐利，上方远景则越来越平滑弥散。油画完成效果庄严而富于气氛，颜色收敛，后退平面的节奏缓慢。
theme_en: A solitary wanderer above a sea of dawn mist
theme_zh: 黎明雾海之上的独行者
name: Caspar David Friedrich
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
